text:
maria-partnerships: FYI vendors sent last-minute gate changes. H100 image delayed ~9d due to microcode; MI300 driver freeze moved by 48h; Gaudi image now ETA +12d. proposal: split announce into two waves and publish an internal fallback matrix.

kevin-platform: we need exact artifact cut times — i'll ask infra to freeze build windows. also recommend automated fallback rules in routing so we can route customers to H200/B200 if H100 fails.

sophie-marketing: split waves works. Wave-1: H200 + B200 (smaller press, earlier); Wave-2: H100 + MI300 + Gaudi (headline). need embargo windows and preferred demo partners.

leila-sis: SI ask 1: can integrators test against canary images? some require full GA images. i'll poll top-4 and collect dry-run availability.

tom-ops: ops note 1: if we stagger, we'll need two separate staged canaries + rollback playbooks. also check capacity for extra certification runs.

embargo-bot: embargo-handshake created: please confirm vendor contact and embargo windows by 2026-04-02 17:00 PT.

maria-partnerships: action items: 1) i will consolidate vendor gate dates into a single checklist (drop one-line risk notes) 2) kevin to confirm artifact cuts 3) leila to collect SI dry-run dates 4) sophie to draft comms for both waves. we'll triage on Thu 09:30 PT.

kevin-platform: small technical note: H100 continuous batching regression observed in our last smoke run. logging snippet: ```WARN kernel: quant-ep flush timeout; retry=1``` might require vendor microcode patch.

sophie-marketing: will hold press slots tentatively but mark as embargo-pending. need final gates 48h before wave.

maria-partnerships: thanks all. please drop your checklist entries before the triage. :thumbsup:
